measured_resume_rate.qualification: Elapsed time includes interruptions, waiting and engineering; not measured continuous active processing time.

workflow_changes: Authors produce canonical records and Reader additions together.
Independent audit remains separate; corrections are consolidated and accepted metadata is settled before hash generation.
Reusable read-only preflight catches record, Reader, review and reagent/state namespace errors before full builds.
Scientific audit binds paper-local immutable deltas; deterministic aggregate updates do not restart unchanged science reviews.
Integration and publication use ready batches and an exception queue.
limits: No paid processing, cloud source transfer or new paper downloads.
Original source files and detailed audit receipts remain local.
